text:
sam_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock the model discovery / capabilities payload for the public discovery endpoint. Customers are asking for: supported tools, streaming support, JSON/structured output hints, and token limits. Can we finalise shape and launch criteria?

ben_eng: I can stub a minimal shape. Proposal: return boolean flags + limits + tool list. e.g.

ben_eng: ```json
{
  "supportsStreaming": true,
  "supportsFunctions": true,
  "supportsStructuredOutput": true,
  "maxContextTokens": 8192,
  "maxResponseTokens": 2048,
  "supportedTools": [
    { "name": "search", "version": "v1", "surface": "http" }
  ],
  "recommendedQuantization": "int8"
}
```

laura_ml: Heads up — exposing raw tool names may leak internal capability. For hosted public responses maybe we return categories (e.g., "tool:retrieval") or an opt-in mapping for enterprise tenants.

alex_devex: From DX: include short human-friendly usage notes per capability + examples so SDKs can show warnings/requirements (e.g., streaming requires client >=1.2).

sam_pm: Proposed launch criteria: 1) API shape stable for canary/dedicated/private, 2) docs + SDK examples, 3) security review + classification, 4) at least 2 pilot customers signed off, 5) graceful fallback when flag=false.

ben_eng: Implementation notes: cache by model+org, keep small TTL. Add a feature flag discovery_v1_enabled to rollout. Also add a contextWindow vs totalTokens field — some models enforce a single hard limit.

laura_ml: Please add structuredOutputSchema boolean and optional schemaUrl (hosted-only). That helps evals and integration tests. Also add "restricted": true for safety-limited models.

tara_product: Customers asked for "tokenLimit" vs separate input/response limits — what's recommended?

ben_eng: We'll expose both: maxContextTokens, maxResponseTokens, and maxTotalTokens if model enforces combined. If maxTotalTokens present it overrides sum.

sam_pm: Updated draft (camelCase per API standards) — include supportsBatching (useful for Dedicated), supportedStreamingFormats ["chunked", "events"], and a short string field usageNotes. Example shape below.

sam_pm: ```json
{
  "supportsStreaming": true,
  "supportedStreamingFormats": ["chunked", "evented"],
  "supportsFunctions": true,
  "supportsStructuredOutput": true,
  "supportsBatching": false,
  "maxContextTokens": 32768,
  "maxResponseTokens": 4096,
  "maxTotalTokens": 32768,
  "supportedTools": ["retrieval", "browser"],
  "structuredOutputSchemaUrl": "https://docs.redwood.ai/models/gptx/schema.json",
  "recommendedQuantization": "int8",
  "restricted": false,
  "usageNotes": "Streaming requires client >=1.2, functions limited to 50 calls/min"
}
```

alex_devex: tiny nit — we use camelCase across APIs, yes. Also add a deprecationNote field for models that will be rotated soon.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-04-03T11:30:00-07:00 :rocket:

ben_eng: I'll open PR with schema + API handler. Will gate by discovery_v1_enabled and a rollout plan. :thumbsup:

laura_ml: I'll do a quick security review for tool exposure and the schemaUrl hosting controls.

alex_devex: I'll add a docs stub and example SDK mapping for JS + Python.

sam_pm: Action items: ben -> PR today, laura -> security review block, alex -> docs stub, tara -> confirm pilot customers. We'll reconvene after PR is up. Thanks all.
